companies.name: HCLTech
companies.description: HCLTech is a global IT services and consulting company operating across 60 countries, offering digital transformation, engineering, cloud, and AI services to enterprises worldwide. The company has been aggressively building agentic AI platforms, integrating with major hyperscaler ecosystems across manufacturing, telecom, financial services, and healthcare.

companies.name: Tech Mahindra
companies.description: Tech Mahindra is a global IT services and consulting company and part of the Mahindra Group, delivering digital transformation, consulting, and business re-engineering services across industries. The company has been aggressively building agentic AI platforms and solutions with a strong focus on telecom, financial services, and healthcare verticals.

companies.name: LTIMindtree
companies.description: LTIMindtree is an Indian multinational IT services and consulting company and a subsidiary of Larsen & Toubro. It operates across 30+ countries, focusing on digital transformation, cloud, and AI-driven enterprise solutions for financial services, healthcare, manufacturing, and retail clients.

agents.tagline: A patented enterprise platform that deploys agentic AI across software engineering, IT operations, and business processes to automate 70% of complex procedures.
agents.description: AI Force is HCLTech's flagship GenAI and Agentic AI automation platform that augments workflows across software engineering, data engineering, IT operations, and enterprise business processes. It features modular sub-platforms (AI Force.Software, AI Force.Ops, AI Force.Data, AI Force for SAP) and supports agent lifecycle management, multi-agent orchestration, and multi-LLM flexibility. The platform includes 50+ pre-built agentic recipes across requirements, development, testing, DevOps, and technical support. It brings prompts, RAG, tools, autonomous agents, governance, and responsible AI together in a single extensible platform that integrates smoothly with existing IT environments.

use_cases.title: Automated code generation and legacy application modernization
AI-driven test case generation and DevSecOps pipeline orchestration
cloud migration automation (rehost, re-factor, re-platform)
service desk modernization with agentic transformation and autonomous ticket resolution

expected_outcomes: Automating 70% of complex procedures
improving productivity by 25-30%
extracting document data with 95% accuracy (F1 score).

agents.tagline: An agentic AI-powered manufacturing solution that detects product defects and anomalies in real time using Google Cloud's Cortex Framework.
agents.description: HCLTech Insight is an agentic AI-powered Industry Focused Repeatable Solution (IFRS) built on Google Cloud's Cortex Framework, Manufacturing Data Engine (MDE), Vertex AI, and Agentic Framework. It equips manufacturers with advanced data insights and analytics capabilities through real-time defect detection and anomaly analysis on production lines. The solution provides interactive dashboards and AI-powered virtual assistance to respond to defects in real time, boosting production quality and cost efficiency. It serves enterprises across automotive, aerospace, and electronics manufacturing verticals.

use_cases.title: Real-time product defect detection and anomaly analysis on production lines
production quality monitoring with interactive AI-powered dashboards
automated root cause analysis for manufacturing process issues
predictive analytics for production efficiency optimization

expected_outcomes: Reduced defect escape rates through real-time anomaly detection
improved production quality and lower scrap/rework costs
faster time-to-insight for manufacturing operations teams.

agents.tagline: A GenAI-powered virtual network troubleshooting agent that detects telecom anomalies in near real time and recommends corrective actions before customers are impacted.
agents.description: NetSight is an AI-powered virtual network troubleshooting agent for telecom operators, powered by Google Cloud Gemini and Vertex AI. It continuously analyzes network data streams using advanced machine learning algorithms to detect anomalies in near real time, identify root causes, uncover performance bottlenecks, and suggest corrective actions such as network configuration modifications. The platform brings predictive insights based on historical demand patterns, ticket logs, and external data sources, correlating faults from fault management systems with network performance spikes. It is listed on Google Cloud's Agent Finder marketplace and enables operators to shift from reactive to proactive network management.

use_cases.title: Proactive network anomaly detection and automated root cause analysis
real-time performance bottleneck identification across RAN networks
predictive network demand forecasting based on historical patterns
customer experience optimization through preemptive fault resolution

expected_outcomes: Shift from reactive to proactive network operations
reduced mean time to resolution (MTTR) for network incidents
improved quality of experience (QoE) for end-users.

agents.tagline: An AI-powered unified contact center platform built with Cisco that replaces legacy systems with multilingual virtual agents and predictive CX monitoring.
agents.description: Fluid Contact Center is an AI-powered unified contact center solution combining Cisco's Webex Contact Center platform with HCLTech's CCaaS transformation expertise. It delivers full AI-driven interaction automation across voice, chat, and digital channels with multilingual virtual agents, conversational IVR, agent-assist tools, analytics, and proactive monitoring. The solution offers enterprises a guided migration path that removes friction from major infrastructure overhauls, enabling adoption of advanced AI features without being locked into legacy ecosystems. It supports omnichannel orchestration with real-time conversation summarization and next-best-action recommendations for live agents.

use_cases.title: AI-driven customer interaction automation across omnichannel touchpoints
multilingual virtual agent handling of routine inquiries at scale
real-time agent-assist with conversation summarization and next-best-action
predictive monitoring to proactively identify and resolve CX issues

expected_outcomes: Reduced average handle time and cost-per-interaction
improved first-contact resolution rates
seamless legacy-to-cloud contact center migration with minimal disruption.

agents.tagline: An enterprise agentic AI platform that lets businesses deploy autonomous AI agents across complex workflows without needing ML expertise.
agents.description: TechM Orion is Tech Mahindra's next-generation agentic AI platform built on NVIDIA accelerated computing. It enables intelligent, autonomous execution of complex business workflows through reusable agents that can reason, plan, and act across enterprise systems by combining large language models, structured data access, and real-time decision-making. The platform features a no-code/low-code interface for business users, plug-and-play integration with enterprise systems, and dual-layer guardrails through TechM VerifAI for monitoring hallucinations, bias, and agent performance. TechM Orion supports flexible deployment across Azure, AWS, GCP, private cloud, or on-premises environments, with a marketplace offering a catalog of autonomous, platform-agnostic agents for enterprise use cases.

use_cases.title: Automating multi-step IT operations workflows
orchestrating customer service processes across channels
deploying domain-specific reasoning agents integrated with existing enterprise data lakes and tools
centralizing AI governance across an organization's agent deployments

expected_outcomes: Faster time-to-value for AI deployments with reduced operational costs
improved operational consistency through autonomous agent execution
reduced complexity in managing enterprise AI at scale.

agents.tagline: A GenAI-powered suite that automates IT and end-user support by replacing traditional Level 1 support with touchless, AI-driven ticket resolution.
agents.description: agentX is Tech Mahindra's comprehensive suite of GenAI solutions, with agentAssistX as its core offering. agentAssistX transforms IT and end-user support by leveraging conversational AI to automatically create, manage, and resolve support tickets without human touchpoints, effectively phasing out traditional L1 support. The solution automates critical functions including meeting room technology operations, software and device management, access and security management, real-time monitoring, knowledge management, and cloud and data center operations. It integrates with conversational AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot, AWS Business Q, and Google Gemini to deliver a seamless, agentless support experience.

use_cases.title: Automating enterprise IT helpdesk operations end-to-end
managing software provisioning and device lifecycle without manual intervention
automating access control and security management workflows
real-time monitoring and knowledge management for cloud and data center operations

expected_outcomes: Enhanced productivity by up to 70% through automation of complex IT tasks
improved compliance and risk mitigation
significant reduction in mean time to resolution for IT support tickets.

agents.tagline: An AI reasoning agent that transforms telecom network operations centers into autonomous, closed-loop systems capable of self-healing at Level 4+ autonomy.
agents.description: This AI-powered reasoning agent is designed to help Communication Service Providers accelerate their journey toward Level 4+ autonomous networks. It performs autonomous alarm validation, root-cause analysis, and resolution across Operations Support Systems and Business Support Systems environments. The agent is built using NVIDIA NeMo with synthetic and anonymized data and deployed as an NVIDIA NIM inference microservice, demonstrating a 2-3x improvement in accuracy compared to non-fine-tuned models. Delivered through the TechM Orion platform, it ensures enterprise-grade trust without using customer PII, allowing CSPs to safely operationalize AI while maintaining data privacy and governance.

use_cases.title: Autonomous alarm triage and root-cause analysis in telecom NOCs
closed-loop incident resolution across OSS/BSS environments
accelerating transition from manual to L4+ autonomous network operations
reducing mean time to repair for network faults

expected_outcomes: 2-3x improvement in reasoning accuracy over non-fine-tuned models
faster incident handling with greater operational consistency
reduced dependency on manual NOC operations staff.
integrations: existing CSP data lakes and OSS/BSS tools

agents.tagline: An agentic AI solution that autonomously manages telecom payment workflows, from risk monitoring to multichannel customer follow-ups, to protect revenue and reduce churn.
agents.description: Available on the AWS Marketplace, this solution transforms human-intensive payment processes into intelligent, agent-driven workflows for global telecom operators. It uses agentic AI to analyze payment behavior, monitor potential payment risks, autonomously assess customer eligibility, and trigger actions such as setting up payment arrangements or initiating follow-ups across messaging platforms, chat, voice, and SMS. The solution integrates with leading billing and CRM platforms, reasoning across multiple data signals, taking autonomous actions, and continuously learning to improve recommendations over time. It balances automation with human oversight for vulnerable customers and complex cases, maintaining regulatory compliance throughout.

use_cases.title: Automating payment risk assessment and collections outreach for telecom subscribers
orchestrating multichannel follow-ups for overdue accounts
setting up autonomous payment arrangements based on customer eligibility analysis
reducing involuntary churn through proactive payment intervention

expected_outcomes: Enhanced revenue protection without compromising customer trust
reduced customer churn through proactive payment management
measurable improvement in collections efficiency with faster deployment via AWS Marketplace availability.

agents.tagline: An AI-native ecosystem that unifies intelligent agents, modular architecture, and built-in governance to move enterprises from AI concept to measurable value.
agents.description: BlueVerse is LTIMindtree's flagship agentic AI platform operated as a dedicated business unit. The platform comprises BlueVerse Foundry, a no-code/pro-code agent composition studio for building and deploying AI agents, RAG pipelines, and intelligent workflows; BlueVerse Marketplace, which hosts 325+ pre-built domain-specific agent blueprints and solution accelerators; and the Agent Orchestration Engine, which manages multi-agent lifecycle and interactions. It includes a centralized policy engine for role-based access control, an Explainability API for step-by-step reasoning trails, and immutable cryptographically signed audit logs for full governance. The platform supports composable agent deployment across enterprise functions with built-in observability and cost tracking.

use_cases.title: Supply chain optimization and demand forecasting
customer support ticket automation with autonomous triage and resolution
procurement workflow automation with spending guardrails
predictive service management and proactive maintenance scheduling

expected_outcomes: 45% reduction in manual support tickets
80% faster task cycle time
90% SLA compliance improvement.

agents.tagline: An enterprise-grade agentic AI ecosystem that orchestrates autonomous insurance agents across the full policy and claims value chain.
agents.description: BlueVerse INS AI is LTIMindtree's insurance-specific AI platform built within the BlueVerse ecosystem. It delivers over 50 insurance-specific AI agents out of a broader catalog of 300+ agents, covering functions from underwriting to claims processing. The platform includes automated data pipelines for structured and unstructured data extraction, intelligent document processing, multi-modal content extraction, and domain-specific insurance data APIs. It provides model lifecycle management with automated feedback collection, fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and governance capabilities built in.

use_cases.title: First Notice of Loss (FNOL) automation that performs real-time loss data validation, customer/policy validation, case creation, and claims note summarization
KYC copilot that analyzes customer information and identifies discrepancies across structured and unstructured data
insurance agent marketplace for configuring and orchestrating line-of-business-specific AI agents

expected_outcomes: Reduced manual effort and error rates in claims intake
real-time fraud detection during FNOL processing.

agents.tagline: A GenAI-powered autonomous sourcing copilot that streamlines indirect procurement from market research through negotiation.
agents.description: Navisource.AI is LTIMindtree's procurement-focused AI copilot built on the BlueVerse platform. It functions as an autonomous sourcing assistant that performs market research, pricing intelligence, supplier recommendations, and AI-driven negotiation. The platform eliminates manual touchpoints across the procurement cycle and enhances collaboration between suppliers, procurement functions, and requestors. It uses GenAI to understand requirements and determine optimal sourcing strategies with cost efficiency as a core objective.

use_cases.title: Automated market research and supplier discovery for indirect procurement
AI-driven pricing intelligence and negotiation support
end-to-end sourcing strategy recommendation from requirement intake to supplier selection
procurement cost benchmarking and optimization

expected_outcomes: 10-15% reduction in overall procurement cost.
